content:
“Take 2 of these and never call me again.”

**Pharmacist** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Increases radiation healing from RadAway and RadAway: diluted based on current Intelligence.

| ![FO76 pharmacist perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/7/7e/FO76_pharmacist_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Intelligence | Radiation Healing | 
| | 1 | +30% | 
| | 15 | +100% | 
| | 30 | +160% | 
| | 60 | +180% | 
| | 100 | +200% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | RadAway removes more radiation based on your INT. | 000814FB | 

- Pharmacist can be stacked with Chem Fiend, as radaway are treated as chems.
- Pharmacist can be stacked with Astoundingly Awesome Tales #13.
- Pharmacist can be sped up with Field Surgeon, but the extra healing provided is unaffected.
- Pharmacist is required in order to craft antibiotics, disease cures and water filters at the chemistry workstation.
